title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-sync-prep-2026-03
content:
Weekly partner/cloud marketplace sync - prep notes (jamie)

Meeting: Partner & Cloud Marketplace Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-03-03 09:00 PT (30-45m)
Attendees (target): Aisha (GTM Leads), Luca (Product), Priya (Sales Eng), Maya (Legal - rotate), AWS rep (TBD), Azure PM (TBD), GCP partner lead (TBD)

Purpose: quick cross-functional status on marketplace listing work, open blockers for cloud marketplace private offers and co-sell, partner enablement items, and prioritized action items for the next week. Keep tight - escalate anything blocking launch timelines.

Agenda (timeboxed)
1) Quick wins / metrics (5m)
   - Listing impressions / click-throughs (last week): check Data Studio; ask Aisha for top-line numbers.
   - AWS Private Offers live customers: 2 in POC, 1 contract signed (Priya update)

2) AWS-specific (10m)
   - Private Offer template: legal comments outstanding (Maya) - need final signoff on pricing clause by 2026-03-10.
   - Procurement + marketplace billing integration: Engineering (ENG-3421) ETA for invoice mapping? Luca: share ETA.
   - Co-sell readiness: confirm AWS partner validation checklist items done (security attestation).

3) Azure / Marketplace + CSP (8m)
   - Azure CSP listing draft stuck on billing SKU mapping — action: Aisha to sync with Azure partner PM this week.
   - Co-marketing asset pack version 1 (slide deck + blog draft) ready? Need approval to share with channel partners.

4) GCP SaaS Marketplace (5m)
   - Status: registration complete; onboarding call scheduled 2026-03-07. Confirm required IAM roles for deployment tests.

5) Channel partners & ISV partners (7m)
   - Partner onboarding playbook: review feedback from AcmeCloud pilot. Add small checklist for SSO + data residency questions.
   - Marketplace referral vs revenue share model discussion (defer to next week if time limited).

6) Open blockers / escalations (5m)
   - SOC2 attestation copy needed by AWS for co-sell campaign — who owns delivery? (Maya to confirm.)
   - Demo environment perf regressions under load for Marketplace listing demo: SRE runbook required.

7) Action items & owners (3m)

Notes / prep items for me (Jamie) before the call:
- Pull last-week marketplace metrics (impressions, installs, leads) from Data Studio + Intercom. Goal: have one slide with top 3 metrics.
- Quick status on AcmeCloud pilot: list active tasks and outstanding asks from their security team.
- Re-run the AWS private offer test flow with updated pricing template (QA) — ask Priya to confirm steps.
- Bring up potential discount band suggestions for marketplace promos (need quick math: margin impact at 10%/20% promo).

Scratchpad talking points / questions to surface:
- For AWS: what exact artifact do they need for co-sell validation? Is the SOC2 pdf enough or do they want a letter from compliance?
- For Azure CSP: what is the expected long lead time for SKU mapping? Do we need to pre-create a SKU inventory table?
- GCP: confirm whether marketplace deployment tests can be run on staging project or requires a prod-like environment.
- Channel partners: are we comfortable with referral leads being routed via Intercom or do partners want a dedicated partner portal?

Follow-up action items (write down during call) - prepopulated where known:
- Aisha: provide impressions & CTR numbers and share Data Studio link by EOD 2026-03-03. (owner: Aisha Khan, due: 2026-03-03)
- Priya: confirm AWS Private Offer signed customer details and share closed-won summary (owner: Priya Singh, due: 2026-03-04)
- Luca: post an update to ENG-3421 with ETA on billing/invoice mapping and required fields for marketplace invoices. (owner: Luca Moreno, due: 2026-03-05)
- Maya: confirm SOC2 artifact format for AWS co-sell and upload to Confluence (confluence:CP-Marketplace-Playbook). (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-06)
- Jamie: draft co-marketing asset pack and share for review (owner: Jamie Park, due: 2026-03-10)
- Engineering: create an SRE demo runbook for Marketplace demo environment (link to PR when ready). (owner: eng-sre, due: 2026-03-09)

Possible risks to call out:
- If billing/invoice mapping for AWS takes >2 weeks, private offer reconciliations will block finance integration for early customers. Need backup plan: manual reconciliations until automation ready.
- Legal turnaround on private offer template could slip - have negotiation fallback language for 1:1 with AWS account team.
- Performance regressions in demo environment could kill planned co-sell demos for March events. Prioritize SRE runbook.

Preparation checklist (jamie):
- [ ] Metrics slide (impressions, CTR, installs, leads)
- [ ] AcmeCloud pilot one-pager (status + asks)
- [ ] Draft co-marketing asset pack (slides + blog outline)
- [ ] Link to ENG-3421 and JIRA tickets in chat for quick reference
- [ ] SOC2 doc link in Confluence

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack/email after sync):
Subject: Partner/Marketplace sync - decisions & actions (mm/dd)
Hi all,
Thanks for joining—quick recap + actions: 
- List 3 bullets of decisions (e.g., AWS PO template accepted pending legal signoff; GCP onboarding call set; Azure CSP SKU work assigned)
- Action owners with due dates (copy from above)
- Next sync: 2026-03-10 09:00 PT (tentative)

Notes to self: keep this doc updated with call notes and move to shared_drives/company/gtm/marketplace once this reaches stable status (status -> in_review / final).

Reference links to collect during meeting:
- Data Studio dashboard (marketplace metrics)
- Confluence: CP-Marketplace-Playbook (listing requirements, legal templates)
- JIRA: GTM-88 (co-marketing collateral tracker), ENG-3421 (billing mapping)
